items.title: Palo Alto Networks Just Dropped 13% in a Month. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysPalo Alto Networks (PANW) stock fell approximately 13% in the month through November 2, closing near $352 as AI competition concerns and cybersecurity valuations pressured shares. CrowdStrike (CRWD) also faced selling pressure, although improving cybersecurity budgets could support demand for its security platform.
